final_retained_full_triples.rationale: The first narrator leaves many of Judas's deeds and battles unwritten because of their abundance; the second describes Judas Maccabeus's campaigns as abundant material to be abridged from five books. Both explain selective narration of Judas's history; this does not identify Jason's work as the first narrator's source.
